items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: Joel's brother John played tuba for Leon.

ctx.x: Joel's brother John played tuba for Leon. But I met John in the '80s through somebody else that I was making records for. And then he died shortly thereafter so I really didn't know him that well but I met him quite a few times during the '80s.

Well the reason I brought it up is I asked him, now this goes back a number of years, but I asked him, because he worked for Atlantic and then he had his own labels. And we were taking about the different delivery system now, from LPs to where things are at now and if it mattered to him. And he goes, "Naa I don't care. I just make the product and whatever they do with it —" so do you care?
